label: POC Onboarding: Verify Resource Handler
mcp_tool_description: Run Verify Connection on a resource handler (RH- id or name) and return the cloud API's real error text, which the UI form replaces with 'Unable to connect to handler with the information provided'. Adds a hint for AWS, Azure, vCenter, SCVMM, GCP, Nutanix and OpenStack errors (bad key, expired secret, wrong tenant, missing role or privilege, TLS, DNS, firewall, proxy), the link to the minimum-permissions document and the handler's edit and verify links, and records the result so onb_status shows it. Runs as a job: poll the returned id with fetch_job and read outputs. Call it after the user creates or edits a handler in the UI; when it fails, give the user the edit link and the hint, never ask for the credentials in chat. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
